form.title: Track an app keyword
form.description: Check the selected store once a week. Adding the keyword uses a tracking slot; checks use your app keyword allowance.
form.phraseHint: Enter one keyword per line, or separate them with commas.

discover.title: Discover keywords for this app
discover.description: Find phrases this app already ranks for in the store, then pick the ones to track.
discover.marketNote: Discovery covers the United States (English) store listing only. It uses one app keyword lookup.
discover.empty: No ranking phrases were found for this app.

list.title: Tracked keywords
list.description: A blank result means the app was not found in the store’s checked depth; no row means the check has not run.

history.title: Position history: {{phrase}}
history.description: First place appears at the top. Weekly checks that did not find the app remain visible in the table.
history.empty: No position checks have run for this keyword yet.

preview.units: This check uses {{units}} app keyword check.
preview.cache: Checks are metered even when stored provider evidence can be reused.

mintPreview.title: Add this tracked keyword?
mintPreview.description: Review the structural slot and the weekly check allowance before confirming.
mintPreview.slotDisclosure: {{used}} of {{limit}} tracking slots are in use.
mintPreview.count: Adding {{count}} keywords. Each uses one tracking slot.

recheck.title: Check this keyword now?
recheck.description: Run this week’s store search for “{{phrase}}”.

empty.noProfileDescription: A tracked keyword needs a registered store ID.
empty.noKeywords: No keywords are tracked for this app yet.

disabled.title: Keyword tracking is not available
disabled.description: This feature is currently switched off. Stored observations remain available through the API.

upsell.title: Add App SEO keyword tracking
upsell.description: Pro accounts need the App SEO add-on or an eligible keyword-check pack before weekly store checks can run.

errors.title: We couldn’t update app keyword tracking
errors.requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Try again.
